away.name: Jakub Dobes
away.news: The Canadiens have relied exclusively on Jacob Fowler between the pipes for their last three games, but they will turn to Dobes on Wednesday for his first start in over a week. Dobes struggled in his most recent game, allowing five goals on 32 shots (.844 SV%) in a 6-4 loss to the Carolina Hurricanes. The 25-year-old Czech goalie is coming off an impressive postseason run and earned a three-year deal worth $5,357,575 AAV ($16.073M total), but he has had an ugly start to the 2026-27 season, posting a 4.43 GAA and .856 SV% in three games (1-1-1). The Canadiens enter Wednesday's contest as +108 road underdogs against a Washington Capitals team on a two-game losing streak (0-2-0).

away.name: Casey DeSmith
away.news: The Stars have been stout defensively early in the 2026-27 season, allowing only 11 goals in six games. Unfortunately for their goaltending tandem of Jake Oettinger and Casey DeSmith, the team's offence has been nearly nonexistent, scoring just 13 goals and paving the way for a subpar 2-3-1 record. DeSmith will return to the crease for only the second time this season. The 35-year-old goalie was solid in his only outing, saving 24 of 26 shots (.923 SV%), but again lacked goal support, as the Stars lost 2-1 to the Nashville Predators. The Stars enter Wednesday's contest as +119 road underdogs against an Avalanche team that beat them 3-2 yesterday.

home.name: Scott Wedgewood
home.news: Surprisingly, Colorado hasn't leaned on Scott Wedgewood much this season and has relied on Blackwood between the pipes in five of their first six games. Wedgewood's tremendous 2025-26 season, posting a 2.02 GAA and .921 SV% in 45 appearances (31-6-6), should at least earn him close to a timeshare by season's end, even if the team is showing early-season favour for Blackwood. The 34-year-old Wedgewood saved 26 of 29 shots (.897 SV%) in his only game this season, a 7-3 win over the Calgary Flames. Colorado enters Wednesday's contest as -131 home favourites against a Dallas Stars team they defeated 3-2 yesterday.
